info.name: RBPO Lab 5 — Personal Budget — Variant 28
info.description: JWT HS256, rotation, replay, roles, CRUD and business operations. Run in order on local test database. Requires existing Test (id 5), Admin, and foreign owner id 3. Financial test objects are created; refresh sessions are retained. Set passwords locally. For SQL audit use deviceId from the first login.

item.name: 01. JWT — вход, refresh, регистрация и роли
